fields.summary_ko.0: MediaTek's Q3 revenue of NT$168.06B grew 18.3% year-over-year; with initial shipments of first-generation AI accelerators underway, Q4 revenue target is $2.5B with 2027 target of approximately $16B.
fields.summary_ko.1: 2027 revenue guidance calls for 40–48% year-over-year growth; smart edge platform represents 58% of Q3 revenue and grew 63%, indicating declining mobile dependence.
